### Added

- (agent-platform) [Add the Platform section with the clusters list](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3564) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Portals that set `gs.features.platformSection.enabled` get a Platform item in the Agent Platform's side rail: its Clusters tab lists every cluster across environments, with search, filters by environment, organization, status and release, a column choice and sorting. Off by default.
- (agent-platform) [Replace an egress policy's credential from the Egress tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3581) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On an organization's Egress tab, people who may manage credentials get `Replace credential` for each credential of an egress policy, as on the Connectors tab. Needs agent-manager 3.2.0 or later.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Say the portal session ended on every Agent Platform read](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3566) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — When the portal signs you out, e.g. after a restart, the Sessions pages, the side rail, Workspaces, Toolchains, model serving and the Tools step say `Your portal session ended` and offer `Sign in again`, instead of `Failed user token verification`.
- (agent-platform) [Show Sign in again on the remaining reads the portal session refused](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3568) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — After the portal session ended, Serve model, Pull model, the workspace editor and the Toolchains tab also show one `Your portal session ended` alert with `Sign in again`, instead of each failed read's own words.
- (agent-platform) [Read selector caps and bound UTF-8 toolsets](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3527) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In the Tools step of creating or editing an agent, you can pick more tools, and problems with the selection show beside Continue. When muster doesn't answer, the step offers a retry and lets you continue.
- (agent-platform, ui-react) [Fit the hosting tables and Add a pool to narrow screens](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3559) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a tablet or a narrow window, Model hosting's tables and the GPU capacity table switch to their compact layout instead of squeezing every column; on a phone, long model config names and Add a pool's loading rows fit the screen.
- (agent-platform, ui-react) [Keep long names and narrow usage tables inside the page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3562) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Long agent names wrap or end in an ellipsis instead of running off the page, the Usage tables show fewer columns in a narrow window, and a narrow New session composer leaves more room for the agent and workspace names.
- (backend) [Pin every Python package of the TechDocs generator](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3555) by [@pipo02mix](https://github.com/pipo02mix) — A component's Docs tab shows its documentation again instead of the error `Command mkdocs failed, exit code 1`.
- (gs) [Remove the Web UI links to happa from the cluster page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3554) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A cluster's page no longer offers a Web UI link to happa, the retired web UI, in its links card; the Grafana dashboard link stays. Instances that configure their own cluster links are unchanged.
- (muster) [Show personal access for connector families](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3542) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On Customize's Connectors tab and a connector's page, a connector family shows your own access instead of `Connected` from server health, and offers one `Sign in` for its instances waiting for you; stopped or failed servers show their state again.
- (ui-react) [Scroll the Customize tab strip and keep page headings their room at narrow widths](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3561) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In a narrow window, the Customize tabs scroll sideways, with buttons at the edges, instead of running off the page; Add connector and the other create and edit flows show their full title, with the steps below.

### Development and CI/CD

- (agent-platform) [Serve the portal's skill repository reads from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3551) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, Customize · Skills, a skill's page and Add skill read made-up skill repositories instead of GitHub.
- (agent-platform, gs, gs-common) [Serve the agent gateway's metrics from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3552) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, the Usage overview, Cost and Your sessions pages show made-up spend, tokens and calls.
- (agent-platform, gs-common, muster) [Switch the fixture data set with a fixtures query parameter](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3547) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, `?fixtures=empty`, `many`, `long-names`, `loading` or `error` switches the made-up data set without a restart. In the portal, the Toolchains tab says `Toolchains could not be checked` with a retry instead of loading forever.
- (ci) [Add a layout check that measures portal pages in fixture mode](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3553) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Adds an agent skill that measures portal pages in fixture mode for layout bugs, such as cut-off text or a page that scrolls sideways.
- (layout-check) [Make typical content fit a rule for tables](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3567) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The tables skill gains the rule that typical content fits its column, and the layout check reports cut headers and cut or wrapped short values.
- (muster) [Serve the connector writes in fixture mode](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3558) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, adding, editing, removing, turning on and off and reconnecting a connector work and go through muster's states.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.40.1...v3.41.0
